slot_note: eleventh root of task190 (batch 1 re-root, 2026-11-01): survey-research-official-statistics anomaly detection spent over architectures 1 to 10; a new client domain (human-factors-ergonomics), world and dataset under the same objective, a pairing (human factors x anomaly detection) never built
niche: an NHS hospital trust's transfusion committee choosing which sample collection areas get a human factors review of patient identification after a wrong blood in tube sample led to an ABO-incompatible transfusion, on each area's 2026 rate of samples taken from a patient other than the one named on the tube
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the laboratory's sample log and the incident register (the collecting area, one record per sample, the investigation's confirmed wrong blood in tube samples only) computes each area's 2026 wrong blood in tube rate as its confirmed samples over its group and screen samples, the laboratory's own measure, and refers the areas over the policy's 1 in 2,000; a sample taken from the wrong patient is found only when the named patient has another group on record and the two groups differ, and the areas whose patients mostly arrive with no earlier sample are the ones whose errors go unfound, so on the rate of samples actually taken from the wrong patient the referred set is different.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each collection area's rate of samples taken from a patient other than the one named on the tube, the patient identification error a transfusion service's human factors work is aimed at, estimated from the error the laboratory can see: a mislabelled sample shows only when its group disagrees with another group held for the named patient.

spine.entity: one group and screen sample received by the transfusion laboratory

world.org_type: an NHS hospital trust with one transfusion laboratory serving its two hospitals' wards and departments

driver: A mislabelled sample is found only when the named person already has another record of the measured property and the two records disagree, so a unit's found errors are its true errors times the share of its samples with a second record times the chance two people differ; units whose people mostly arrive with no earlier record have their errors unfound, and a ranking on found errors per sample refers the units that see returning people and passes over the ones that see new ones.
stump: A competent solver counts each collection area's confirmed wrong blood in tube samples in 2026 over its group and screen samples and refers the areas over 1 in 2,000; a wrong patient's blood is found only where the named patient has a historical or confirmatory group and the two ABO and RhD groups differ, so the emergency department's and maternity's errors mostly go unfound, and on the rate of samples taken from the wrong patient they are over the line.

differentiation.task192: task192 v3 carries an instrument's per-class behaviour from a validation batch that covered only the window's opening into a population whose class mix moved; task190 v11 has no instrument to validate and no mix shift: an error is visible only where a second record of the named person exists and happens to differ, and the found share is that availability times a chance of two people differing.
differentiation.task270: task270 v2 recovers events members chose not to report because reporting cost them more than absorbing the event; task190 v11's missing errors are not withheld by anyone, every sample is tested, and an error stays unseen because the named patient has no other group on record or shares the wrong patient's group.
differentiation.task170: task170 v5 is the train data entry error probability falling with each driver's count of start-ups, a learning curve; task190 v11 has no learning and no practice count, the error rate is fixed by area and the found rate is cut by the record's power to see an error.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the stock of undetected cases a scarce reviewer would meet, which is each unit's arrival rate multiplied by how long a case goes unseen there, so ranking units by the cases they confirm ranks them by arrivals alone.

lineage.fate: spent after three judge passes, the third NOT_DETERMINISTIC on an averaging estimator the pack files nowhere
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many items were placed just under a threshold to stay under it, and the practice that placed them there leaves a matching shortfall just over the threshold, because the item each one replaced is not in the record any more.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4, NOT_DETERMINISTIC SEND_BACK; Gate B forced the reliability factor table to ship and shipping it made the projection route recoverable, so Gate F fell
lineage.driver: Items were drawn into the tested set with probability proportional to their size, so a tested item stands for a fixed amount of the population rather than for one item, and every item above that amount was certain to be drawn and stands only for itself.

lineage.fate: abandoned on a model constraint rather than a design finding (two builder sessions terminated by an API safeguard on the ground's subject matter), and separately measured dead in four parameterisations
lineage.driver: A detector setting is worth what each episode still has ahead of it when that setting's own alert fires, so the settings can only be compared by summing every episode's remaining volume at the firing time each setting itself produces.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 1 on measurement, nothing cut: eleven candidate decisive steps died on the WHAT screen, the swap test or the corpus, and the one that cleared both, a near-repeat clustering ratio against its own Knox pair margins, died because the plain share of addresses burgled more than once reaches the designed winner at every boost by a wider margin (1.50x to 2.89x) than the decisive step (1.26x to 1.46x)
lineage.driver: Burglaries falling close together in place and time more often than each area's own spatial and temporal pair margins imply rank the areas for a post-event response, against the raw close-pair count.

lineage.niche: a national environment statistics institute's plan-attainment review of business waste recovery, finding which of eight statistical waste streams the 2026 recovery share is established below its National Waste Management Plan target for, so the collection division can commit its single 2027 supplementary field module
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a ratio whose numerator is a complete administrative total and whose denominator is an estimate from a stratified probability sample, so none of the ratio's error comes from the numerator and none from the units the design enumerated completely; the member whose denominator sits almost wholly among those enumerated units is the only one whose gap against a fixed published reference is established, while the member with the largest raw gap, the most sampled records and the largest totals has a gap well inside its own interval, so every route that reads precision off a record count, off an overall published precision figure, or off a design variance computed without the correction for complete enumeration names that member instead.
lineage.stump: A competent solver computes every stream's 2026 recovery share correctly, ranks the shortfalls against the plan targets or tests them with a record-count or published-national precision figure, and names mixed commercial and industrial wastes, whose shortfall is the largest in points and clears every such test; the design variance of the arisings estimate, with the completely enumerated stratum contributing nothing, leaves metal and metal-bearing wastes as the only stream established below target.
